queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Monotype Connect' AND publisher LIKE '%Monotype%';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name = 'Monotype Connect' AND publisher LIKE '%Monotype%' AND version_compare(version, '29.0.0') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'monotype connect.exe');
